models.name: TACO-YOLO

models.name: TACO-YOLO-ResNet post-trained
models.description: TACO YOLO finds objects; C4 ResNet was post-trained for 10 epochs on TACO training crops, with epoch 9 selected on validation. Six material labels.

models.name: SortWaste-YOLO-ResNet post-trained
models.description: SortWaste YOLO with C4 ResNet post-trained for 10 epochs on SortWaste training crops; epoch 3 selected on validation. Cartons have no separate label.

models.name: SortWaste-YOLO-ResNet (no post-training)
models.description: SortWaste YOLO with the original C4 ResNet trained on TrashNet, RealWaste and SortWaste; no additional pipeline post-training. Cartons have no separate label.
